title: Zeta research: what we tried and why
scope: Selected routes documented in the frozen 411-page main reader; not an exhaustive account of the literature corpus or every sidebar, and not a statement that later work does not exist.
overall_aim: Reconstruct the zeta literature and investigate explicit connections to the supplied geometric and fluid constructions, keeping the original equations, source attribution and full mathematical work accessible. The broader motivation was to learn what these constructions actually carry into arithmetic, including whether they could reach an RH-relevant criterion.
motivation_policy: The broad motivation follows the owner's stated research direction. The short route rationales below are reconstructed from the written arguments, not claimed as verbatim historical statements of intent.
evidence_policy: These are descriptive accounts of existing written calculations and recorded checks. This editorial pass reads the cited passages and verifies artifact identity; it does not rerun the mathematical computations or independently replay the imported Navier–Stokes existence theorem. Incomplete means incomplete in the cited work, not unknown throughout mathematics.

attempts.title: Keep the branches, then transport the equations
attempts.aim: Carry the supplied polynomial mechanism into fluid and arithmetic coordinates without losing inverse branches.
attempts.why_it_looked_promising: Its inverse-fibre geometry exposes precisely where projection loses information.
attempts.tried: Constructed the full cubic inverse chart, exceptional fibres, incompressible trajectories and transformed diffusion operators.
attempts.outcome: Obtained exact maps and an escaping trajectory in the retained pullback metric.
attempts.extent_and_unfinished: That metric is incomplete; this route did not itself produce a classical Euclidean Navier–Stokes singularity or an off-critical zeta zero. The later work therefore also uses the actual released fluid field.

attempts.title: Test the negative coefficient in the complete Weil form
attempts.aim: Determine whether the coefficient-level negative signal survives in an RH-relevant quadratic test.
attempts.why_it_looked_promising: The retained coefficient acts on the actual theta input whose Fourier transform is Xi.
attempts.tried: Evaluated the complete Weil form, retaining pole, gamma and prime-power terms, cross terms and infinite-tail bounds.
attempts.outcome: The recorded certified value is positive, approximately 2.0984855607004 × 10⁻¹¹.
attempts.extent_and_unfinished: This particular input is not a negative Weil witness. The calculation neither proves global Weil positivity nor settles RH; the negative linear coefficient remains a different, explicitly related calculation.

attempts.title: Transport the actual concentrating swirl into arithmetic
attempts.aim: Propagate the released corrected fluid field itself, rather than infer its behaviour from an analogy.
attempts.why_it_looked_promising: Angular momentum retains a concentrating source component and admits explicit dilation and Mellin maps.
attempts.tried: Kept both nonlinear fluxes, force, viscosity and the projection remainder; constructed the arithmetic map and inverse, then examined the fixed-axis derivative.
attempts.outcome: The written calculation obtains a directly growing arithmetic derivative and an equal genuine Mellin residue at s = −1.
attempts.extent_and_unfinished: This is a precise transported signal, not an off-critical zeta zero. Independent verification of the imported complete source existence theorem is unfinished.

sources.additional_read: Final 120 lines: complete inverse, arithmetic equation, concentrating circle and zero-factor map.

attempts.title: Recover data hidden by trivial-zero cancellation
attempts.aim: Find where higher radial information goes when a zeta factor cancels its Mellin pole.
attempts.why_it_looked_promising: A cancelled pole need not mean that the input coefficient has disappeared.
attempts.tried: Expanded the full Mellin product at negative integers and retained the local zeta factors.
attempts.outcome: Odd Taylor coefficients are recovered from residues; even coefficients from regular values divided by the nonzero derivative of the multiplier.
attempts.extent_and_unfinished: This recovers the complete Taylor sequence, not an arbitrary smooth germ from that sequence alone. Flat remainders remain in the full invertible transform; no new nontrivial zeta zero is obtained.

attempts.title: Make the higher radial source data constructive
attempts.aim: Extend the axis calculation beyond its first derivative without replacing the complete corrected field.
attempts.why_it_looked_promising: The preceding second-coefficient cancellation suggested finite source dependence at each fixed radial degree.
attempts.tried: Derived the coupled coefficient recursion with pressure, viscosity and cutoff terms, then carried it into residue/value coordinates.
attempts.outcome: The written induction gives vanishing above correction order n > m and a finite algorithm for every fixed Taylor degree.
attempts.extent_and_unfinished: This is not convergence of the uncut series or an autonomous finite-dimensional fluid system. The full functions, nonlinear fluxes and flat remainders remain necessary.

maintenance_rule: For each consequential attempt or change of direction, briefly record the aim, broader motivation, heuristic rationale, what was tried, what happened, achieved scope, and unfinished work with source/version links. Preserve previous attempts and corrections. Do not turn the account into compulsory successor tasks or substitute it for full proofs.
